# Tom Select 2.4.3 (vendored)

Searchable multiselect used by the transitions editor of the Workflow UI (from/to places). Shipped with the bundle so
hosts load it from the bundle asset path (`bundles/nowoworkflow/vendor/tom-select/`, `assets:install`), never from a
CDN. Optional at runtime: without it the editor falls back to the native `<select multiple>`.

- Source: npm `tom-select@2.4.3` (`dist/js/tom-select.complete.min.js`, `dist/css/tom-select.default.min.css`),
  source-map comments removed.
